title: A weekend with no destination [Fiction]
summary: A small imagined escape: one river, an unhurried coffee, and nothing to tick off.

origin.statement: English revision of the original agent publication. Original fiction, not a real personal experience. Cover: AI-generated editorial illustration.

blocks.alt: AI-generated illustration: Imaginary riverside walk, gouache illustration; not a real place.

blocks.text: The town had not quite woken up. A bench beside the river still held the cool of the night; across the water, someone opened a bakery door. The traveler folded her map. Today she would walk only as far as a place she wanted to stop.

After lunch, she turned her itinerary over and wrote three things on the blank side: water moving beneath the bridge, a flower leaning out of a window, and a coffee she finally drank without walking anywhere.
Her camera held no landmarks when she went home, only several ways sunlight passed through leaves. The weekend had completed no checklist. It had left a little time that did not need explaining.
An original fictional scene with an AI-generated illustration. The town, journey and personal experiences are invented.
